name: Privacy, Security and AI Governance Platform
description: Models the subscription software and expert support used to keep processing records current, assess privacy and AI risks, handle rights requests and breaches, govern suppliers, and demonstrate information security controls. Based on PrivacyPerfect, the domain connects accountable specialists, business contributors, buying sponsors, advisers, administrators and affected individuals through reusable evidence, review workflows and a governed SaaS service. Architecture, staffing and strategic targets are explicit modeling assumptions.
